tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Services one human in Limassol, Cyprus performs for autonomous agents in the physical world (infrastructure, continuity, nominee holding, errands, observation, representation), with tiers, EUR prices from 200, payment flows and the current sales mode. Free; creates no order.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Evidence for checking the human provider and the signed offer independently: the offer text's SHA-256, wallet addresses, BIP-322, EIP-191 and GPG signatures, the DNS TXT record, GPG key locations, the terms hash and the current pulse. Returns verification material; it does not itself certify identit

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: A price estimate for a service at a price inside its tier: the amount in USDC or EURC on Base at the ECB rate of the day. Not payable and creates nothing; to order, use request_action.

tools.name: request_action
tools.description: Requests a task from the human provider, free. Either catalogue_id (a fixed position: technical verdict 250 EUR, infrastructure rescue 450 EUR with a 200 EUR diagnostic first, signed observation in Cyprus from 200 EUR) or service_id with price_eur; payer is the address you will pay from. The provide

tools.name: submit_escrow_signature
tools.description: After request_action with payment_flow escrow: submits your EIP-712 signature of typed_data (ReceiveWithAuthorization). This grants the escrow's collector the authority to pull the stated USDC amount when the provider authorizes; no transfer happens on submission. If the provider does not authorize

tools.name: report_payment
tools.description: Submits the Base transaction hash of a transfer you already made against an invoice, for reconciliation; it does not initiate a transfer. Checked on-chain: token, recipient, amount, a block after the invoice was issued and before it expired, 12 confirmations. One transaction pays one invoice.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Reads the recorded status of a task (task_…) or an invoice (inv_…), including the escrow state. A confirmed payment does not mean the work is complete.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Reads the record of a paid invoice: transaction, payer, confirmations, EUR rate on the payment day. It is a payment record, not proof of completed work; a receipt signed offline by the provider can be requested with leave_message.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Notifies the provider of a private dispute about a task or invoice (terms, section 12); never published. Marks the task disputed; it does not freeze escrow or refund automatically. The provider answers within 72 hours to reply_to.

tools.name: leave_message
tools.description: A free message to the human provider, the same as POST /inbox. A feasibility question before ordering is answered within 1 hour every day 07:00–18:00 Cyprus time, otherwise within 24 hours. Published on the public board unless private is true; reply_to is never published.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_escrow_signature" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
